title: Services
hint: The apps from vastleggen.py, with their snapshots and screenshots.
intro: A service is an app behind NPM. For each service, cssthema keeps what vastleggen.py captured on your PC: the page (without scripts), the app's CSS and three screenshots: original (without theme), with theme (as the app looked then) and mobile. The editor can then preview a theme against that page.
uploadIntro: Choose the zip parts of a run (vastgelegd-deel1.zip, vastgelegd-deel2.zip, …). They are sent to the server one after the other. An existing service is updated; uploading the same page again replaces its previous snapshot.
dropHint: Drop the zips here, or choose them.
dropLimits: Only .zip, at most 25 MB per file. Several at once is fine.
problemTooLarge: Larger than 25 MB. Upload the parts from vastleggen.py separately (each at most 24 MB).
helpSummary: How do I make such a zip?
helpSetup: Once on your PC: install Playwright and log in to NPM (a browser window opens).
helpRun: Capture all services (headless). A next run continues where the previous one stopped.
helpUpload: Then upload the zip parts here: vastgelegd-deel1.zip, vastgelegd-deel2.zip, … (each at most 24 MB).
loadError: The services could not be loaded
emptyText: Services come from the zips of vastleggen.py, the script that captures the web interface of all your apps. This is how you make them:
noDocumentHint: There is no captured page (e.g. the app did not respond): only status and screenshots. The editor cannot preview against it.
shadowDomHint: The page uses shadow DOM: CSS from outside does not reach those parts.
cspErrorsHint: The app's CSP blocked the theme when it was captured.
statusHintOk: The app was captured as you see it after logging in.
statusHintLogin: vastleggen.py saw a login page. Log in with python vastleggen.py login and capture the app again.
statusHintAuthentik: vastleggen.py ended up on the Authentik login. Log in with python vastleggen.py login and capture the app again.
statusHintNotHtml: The app answered without an HTML page.
statusHintError: Capturing failed (e.g. the app did not respond).
statusHintHttp: The app answered with an HTTP error.
shotOriginalHint: Without theme: how the app looks on its own.
shotThemedHint: With the theme the app had when it was captured.
openFull: Full size in a new tab
deleteText_one: {host} and its snapshot disappear from the list. A new import from vastleggen.py brings it back.
deleteText_other: {host} and its {count} snapshots disappear from the list. A new import from vastleggen.py brings it back.
errorInvalidZip: Not a valid zip from vastleggen.py.
